name: Deen Tok
description: You are a senior full-stack software engineer and UI/UX designer. Build a professional short-video social media platform called "DeenTok". Important: - This is NOT an AI-powered app. - Do NOT use Gemini API or any AI API. - The app must work through the internet using a real backend, database, and cloud storage. - AI features may be added later. - Build it as a production-ready web application that can later be converted into Android and iOS apps. Platform name: DeenTok Meaning: DeenTok represents freedom, creativity, and sharing voices. Main goal: Create a modern short-video platform where users can upload, watch, discover, and interact with videos. Main sections: 1. For You 2. Following 3. Explore 4. Upload 5. Live (future placeholder) 6. Messages 7. Notifications 8. Profile 9. Settings 10. Creator Studio 11. Admin Dashboard Technical requirements: - Modern responsive web design - Mobile-first interface - Fast loading - Secure authentication - Real database connection - Real video storage - Scalable backend structure Development rules: - Write clean, maintainable code. - Create a professional folder structure. - Explain every major step before implementation. - Do not create fake demo-only features. - Do not hardcode data that should come from the database. - Prepare the architecture for future Android and iOS apps. Before writing code: 1. Explain the recommended technology stack. 2. Explain the database structure. 3. Explain the folder structure. 4. Create a development roadmap. Then wait for my next instruction before building.
